description: A document past the documented 25,000-sections-per-document scale limit, producing the structured 413 that carries limit_expandable: true, plus the documented recovery path.

detail.message: This document comes to roughly 6,400 pages, which crosses our standard limit of about 6,250 pages for a single document. This is a stability limit, not a hard cap: the platform supports larger deployments. Use Request higher limit (one click here, or the request_limit_increase call on the API/MCP) and we will expand your account's limits, typically within a day. Omkar is notified automatically; you can also email him at hello@superdocs.app. Meanwhile, you can split the file into smaller documents, or upload it as an attachment to reference and search.

request_increase.agent_hint: Call the request_limit_increase tool (POST /v1/limits/increase-request) with kind and attempted_pages to request an expansion in one call; the team is notified with your account details and typically expands limits within a day. For additional documents you can also start another session (init_session) or close documents you no longer need (close_session_document).
